annotations.title: Whole-menu review: what to fix first (paid, $1)

description:
Whole-menu review from head chef Cristopher's verified costing rules. Send every dish: menu price and ingredient lines or plate cost, optional section and a week of units sold. Get plate cost with his trim and cook loss on brisket, lamb leg, salmon and 30+ more, food cost %, on target or over, price at target, Star, Plowhorse, Puzzle or Dog, and fix these first ranked by weekly margin shortfall, with re-cost advice and workings. Only a 200 answer is charged; refusals and 404s are free.

Use when the user wants their whole menu reviewed at once. Send 2-200 dishes, each with name, menuPrice (as shown on the menu) and either lines or plateCost; add unitsSold (one week) for every dish or none, for classes and the fix-first ranking. For one dish only, use calculate_menu_price; for classes from plate costs alone, calculate_menu_engineering costs less. Pass on each dish's action and price advice as given. Costs $1. Paid automatically in USDC with x402 (test USDC when this server is set to base-sepolia), within this server's per-session and per-day spend caps. Only a 200 answer is charged; 400, 404 and 422 are free. Set dryRun to true to check for free whether this would be answered and what it costs; nothing is signed. If unsure what is covered, call check_coverage first (free). Not every answer is chef-verified: say "chef-verified by Cristopher" only when the result's label says exactly that; otherwise say it is not chef-verified. A refusal is final: don't rephrase the question to get around it.

packPrice.description: The price of one pack as bought.

qty.description: How much goes on the plate, in the pack's unit (or in `unit`).

unit.description: With packUnit, to convert; leave both out when qty and packSize are in the same unit.

yieldPct.description: The usable % of the pack after trim.

unitsSold.description: Units sold in one week. For every dish or none.

dryRun.description: Free quote only: check whether this would be answered and what it costs. Nothing is signed or charged.
